Name: SoManyButtons
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
[center][color=#a4c2f4][size=5][b]SoManyButtons[/b][/size][/color][/center]

A simple framework that lets you customize the Virtual Joypad stick and buttons with HD PNGs of your choice. Mobile only.

‎[i]If you use [color=#f1c232][b]Cinderbox[/b][/color], this is a part of the [b]Cinderbox Pack[/b] file that can be downloaded during setup and on the Home screen.[/i]

[line]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]How To Make Your Own[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b]1. Create Your Folder[/b][/size]
Create a folder with the tag [b][VB][/b] in front of your mod name.
Example: [VB] MyVirtualButtons

[size=3][b]2. Add Your Images[/b][/size]
Place PNG files inside the folder using these names (square images work best for buttons):

[list]
[*][b]all.png[/b] — Applies to joystick, knob, and buttons[/*]
[*][b]joystick.png[/b] — Joystick only[/*]
[*][b]button.png[/b] — Buttons only[/*]
[*][b]knob.png[/b] — Knob only (Cinderbox Launcher)[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]3. Multiple Images (Optional)[/b][/size]
To include multiple images in a single folder, number them:
[code]all.png, all1.png, all2.png, joystick.png, joystick1.png, joystick2.png[/code]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]How To Set Them In Game[/b][/size][/color]

In the options page, select [b]Virtual Button Skins[/b] button. A customization menu will appear if you have any [b][VB][/b] mods installed.


An example on how to use this framework can be found here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43239]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43239[/url]
‎‎
